title: Keystore cache staleness causing transient rolebinding mismatches and dropped audit events on Private clusters
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Multiple customers running Private clusters reported transient 403s and missing audit entries during KMS envelope rotation windows. Investigation shows a control-plane keystore cache staleness bug where nodes continued using an expired local keycache after a remote rewrap event. That caused ephemeral assertion decrypts to fail intermittently, leading to RBAC rolebinding reconciliation skipping newly authenticated sessions and an audit pipeline dropping events under backpressure. This ticket tracks the urgent patch, testing, and rollout to prevent customer-facing authorization failures and audit loss.
observed_behavior: During KMS rewrap windows some control-plane nodes failed to decrypt service assertions (DecryptError). Affected sessions showed: 1) auth succeeded upstream but service returned 403 because rolebinding reconciliation could not resolve tenant claims; 2) audit events for those auth attempts were occasionally dropped when KMS rewrap coincided with high write latency to the audit-forwarder. Impact was intermittent but customer-visible for 10-120s bursts.
root_cause: A race between KMS rewrap handler and keystore cache TTL refresh: when an envelope rotation occurs the keystore refresh was scheduled but not coordinated with in-flight decrypts. Nodes used stale local key material for a short window causing DecryptErrors. The audit-forwarder had no short-term local buffering and dropped events when downstream (log-indexer) backpressure spiked during rotation.
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy Private control plane with local keystore cache TTL configured to 30s.
Trigger a KMS envelope rotation (test rotation API) while sending auth assertions at 200rps.
Observe transient DecryptError on a subset of nodes and 403s for affected sessions.
Check control-plane logs for 'keystore: stale cache' and audit-forwarder logs for 'writeback backpressure' and dropped events counter.
mitigation: Rollback: N/A for KMS rotation; advised customers to schedule rotations during low traffic windows as immediate mitigation.
Short-term: Increase keystore cache TTL to 120s to reduce window of race for customers while patch is prepared.
Temporary: Enable audit-forwarder local-file-buffer (config toggle) to avoid immediate drops.
Long-term: Deploy hotfix described below and run canary rollout.
fix_summary: 1) Make keystore refresh atomic with respect to in-flight decrypts: add versioned keystore handle and swap under lock; add deterministic retry on DecryptError with exponential backoff (max 3 attempts) to allow immediate refresh to succeed. 2) Add a bounded local audit buffer (disk-backed queue) with retry logic and backpressure shaping to prevent event loss during downstream latency spikes. 3) Add reconciliation job to find recent sessions that failed rolebinding reconciliation and re-evaluate claims for up to 5 minutes after a decrypt success. 4) Add telemetry counters and an alert for decrypt_failure_rate and audit_buffer_shed_count.
rollout_plan: Internal review: Security + Infra review completed 2026-03-13 21:00 UTC
Canary: deploy to 3 control-plane nodes in us-west-2 private region (canary) for 30m
If canary stable (no DecryptError spikes, buffer drain healthy), promote to remaining control-plane nodes in the region over 1 hour
Global rollout over 6 hours with staged waves and compensating toggles (disable retry/backoff via feature flag if regressions seen)
Post-rollout: run reconciliation job and monitor audit backlog until zero.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for keystore atomic-swap and decrypt retry logic (coverage + edge cases).
Integration test: simulated KMS rotation in CI cluster with concurrent auth traffic (200rps) validating no DecryptErrors observed after patch.
E2E test: validate audit-forwarder persists to local buffer and drains to indexer on restored connectivity.
Manual UAT: performed against customer repro environment provided by ACME Corp (ticket #C-90412).
